McNeese gears up to host Tarleton State

By Jack Meyer
Published: Sep. 12, 2026 at 2:57 PM EDT
Add Us On GoogleAdd as a preferred source on Google
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

LAKE CHARLES, La. (KPLC) - The McNeese Cowboys are back at Navarre Stadium tonight, this time playing host to the Tarleton State Texans. Kickoff is set for 6 p.m.

WHERE TO WATCH:

  • TV: ESPN+
  • Radio: 92.9 The Lake and 929thelake.com 

MCNEESE FOOTBALL COVERAGE:

  • McNeese routs Texas Wesleyan for first win of 2026 season
  • McNeese drops season opener to Stephen F. Austin
  • Local businesses to see boost as McNeese football season kicks off
  • McNeese football completes first fall scrimmage

Stay with KPLC for highlights from tonight’s game online and on 7 News Nightcast.
